factProposals.value: Pushed GIS features are read back and compared; a mismatch is audited as gis.verify_failed.
Sync errors are reviewable with npm run gis-log (-- --errors), GET /api/gis/log and GET /api/gis/status.
A whole-layer comparison runs at least daily (or with --reconcile) and finds deleted features and edits that skipped editor tracking; deleted features are not recreated.

decisions.statement: Spatial problems are flagged, never corrected: changed location text opens a location_review, and an invalid or out-of-area point never replaces a good one.
A run lock stops two sync jobs racing, and every stopped run is audited as gis.sync_failed with stage, asset, error and a next step.
decisions.rationale: two jobs could otherwise write the same feature twice

decisions.statement: Synchronization logs live in the append-only audit trail.

limitations.statement: Accuracy is proven only as read back from the SIMULATED stand-in, not against ArcGIS Enterprise 11.3.
The out-of-area check needs the layer to publish an extent and only applies to point layers.
The audit trail has no retention or archiving policy, and gis.sync_run adds a row on every run.
ESRI error code 1019 for a missing feature needs checking against real 11.3.
